A1.justification: Both PDFs contain 33 readable pages of the same work, including Appendices A–D. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the scientific material is unchanged.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original quadratic simulations and experiments on Franke regression, Poisson PINNs, and Green's-function learning.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the original quadratic simulations and results for Franke regression, Poisson PINNs, and Green's-function learning.

M1.justification: The preconditioned SGD update in Eq. (2), practical preconditioner constructions, and experimental optimization procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: The quadratic diagnostic and three SciML benchmarks retain identical coverage, including both diffusion and convection-diffusion Green's-function cases.

E2.justification: Both versions evaluate the same quadratic preconditioner variants and SciML optimizer set: SGD, momentum SGD, Adam, L-BFGS, CG-Hessian, and CG-GGN.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D retain the same sampling, architectures, Adam warm starts, switch epochs, learning-rate searches, training budgets, and loss/time evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The spectral-deflation analysis in Figure 1, Green's-function and operator checks in Figures 4–5, and conditioning/noise diagnostics in Section 4.5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report 30 runs for the quadratic diagnostic and five runs for the SciML experiments, with identical seed information and appendix variance-band reporting.

E6.justification: The result curves, numerical conditioning/noise-reduction factors, rankings, and qualitative findings in Section 4 and Appendix D are identical. No result entries were added or removed.

T1.justification: Section 3's definitions, assumptions, convergence theorems, and basin-stability bounds are unchanged, as are the mathematical preliminaries and proofs in Appendices B–C.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about convergence rates, noise floors, basin stability, and preconditioner design.

C2.justification: The conditioning and noise-attenuation interpretations remain identical, including qualifications concerning fixed metrics, local-basin comparisons, and generalization.

D1.justification: Appendix D's software, hardware, precision, network, and conjugate-gradient details are unchanged. Section 4.2 retains the same code/data availability statement.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to existing preconditioners, and bibliography are identical. The new funding acknowledgments introduce no research citations.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short Acknowledgments section on page 14 identifying NSF support and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and existing section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgments heading and paragraph occupy previously blank space on page 14, producing a small local layout addition. Figures 1–9, Table 1, and their placements are unchanged; 31 pages are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution and updates the arXiv stamp. The arguments, proofs, experimental evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
